changelog:
✨ CodeBuddy: models are fetched from each region's live catalog, with a built-in list as fallback.
✨ Auto route: a model that fails before answering is rerouted to another account/model, and a tier entry naming a real model (e.g. glm-5.3) no longer also claims its variants (glm-5.3-flash).
🐛 Fix: CodeBuddy model details no longer go stale across account refreshes, and withdrawn models that answered with an empty reply now fail over.
✨ CodeBuddy：模型列表改为从各区域实时目录获取，失败时使用内置列表。
✨ 自动路由：模型在输出前失败时会改用其他账号/模型；层级中填写的具体模型名（如 glm-5.3）不再同时匹配其变体（glm-5.3-flash）。
🐛 修复：账号刷新后 CodeBuddy 模型信息不再过期；已下线模型返回空回复时现在会自动切换。
